goal: Train Chromantis for RSV with the flu workflow (B7/tree-20261010 training route), assuming the same data availability as flu: recipe search organized as a tree, rooted at the flu finalists, plus a covariate branch.
data: Shared panel data/processed/panel.npz (built 2026-10-05, truth day 2026-09-22), copied to data/processed/panel-rsv.npz with NHSN RSV admissions treated as unobserved before the week ending 2024-11-02 (truth, every report vintage and the RSV Hub-deadline vintages). Reason: NHSN RSV reporting was voluntary and incomplete before mandatory reporting (US peak 315/week in 2023-24 vs about 16,000 in 2024-25), a different quantity from the later counts. User request 2026-10-13; masking date chosen by Claude. RSV ED shares are unchanged from 2022-10.
problem_in_words: RSV admissions and RSV ED share, weeks 1-4 ahead. Leave-one-season-out: each of 2024-25 and 2025-26 held out in turn (the only seasons with complete RSV admissions); each fold trains on the other three of 2022-23..2025-26, where 2022-23 and 2023-24 contribute RSV ED labels and input histories only. Training labels are the latest finalized future values. Evaluation inputs are three artificial preliminary histories drawn from the prescribed 2025-26 RSV reporting process, shared by every recipe and seed. Inputs are read at the RSV Hub deadline.
covariate_problem: problems/us-rsv-short-term-prescribed-covariate-errors.json: same, and the prescribed process also perturbs covariates at evaluation; covariate recipes train with error_signals=all.
training_architecture: B7 / tree-20261010 training route unchanged; the recipes are the flu recipes with RSV targets.
selection_score: States/DC mean log(1 + admissions) WIS over every October-May reference date, horizons 0-3, seasons weighted equally; lower is better. Recipes and groups are finally selected on the score of their seed mixture (as in production), per-seed averages judge each tree step. Native admissions WIS, ED WIS, US log WIS, October-only WIS and coverage are reported, not ranked. RSV Hub pairwise comparison only exists for 2025-26.
expansion_rule: As tree-20261010 (amended): four seeds per node from round 1; a child counts as better than its parent only if lower by more than the pooled seed noise; next round expands the four best nodes and combines settings that helped.
decisions: 2026-10-13: round 1 = six roots (flu finalists Bes, Ba_ll, Bblk, A4 and B7 recipes B_width256, A_blocks3) and 21 children: for Bes error strength 2, log-loss weight 0.25/1, calendar off, lookback 8/16, cross-pathogen input histories (flu+RSV, all six), learning rate x0.5/x2, width 128/512, all actual reports, no spatial exchange, weight decay 1e-4, 2 reconstruction weeks; for A4 Kinsa off, all six input histories, calendar off, log-loss 0.5; for Ba_ll all six input histories. Covariate branch (14 configurations) launched in parallel on Bes and A4: none, RSV wastewater level-like, RSV wastewater percentile rank, Kinsa, ILINet, wastewater+Kinsa, wastewater with growth encoder. Experiments rsv-tree-20261013-r01 (108 runs, Slurm 4792616 on 4 L40) and rsv-tree-20261013-cov (56 runs, Slurm 4792617 on 2 H100).

2026-10-13, after round 1 (108/108 runs, ranking rsv-tree-20261013-r01/ranking-9c45e3156565) and covariate branch (56/56, rsv-tree-20261013-cov/ranking-01100be7f4d5). States/DC log(1+admissions) WIS, 4-seed mean (lower is better); seed SD of single runs about 0.02, so about 0.01 for a 4-seed mean. The flu production recipe Bes scored 0.383, B_width256 (no error-strength increase) 0.363. Cross-pathogen input histories (all six admission/ED signals) helped every family: Ba_ll 0.361 -> 0.331, A4 0.400 -> 0.336, Bes 0.383 -> 0.354 (flu+RSV inputs 0.350). Calendar off helped A4 (0.400 -> 0.338) and Bes (0.383 -> 0.360). Width 512 0.345 and lookback 8 0.348 helped Bes; lookback 16, half learning rate, no spatial exchange, width 128, log-loss 1 worse. Bblk (B_blocks3, log-loss 1, doubled learning rate) 0.339. All recipes under-cover (50% interval coverage 0.35-0.49, 95% 0.75-0.88). RSV Hub 2025-26 pairwise (log admissions, 7 qualifying models): Ba_ll.inputs_all relative WIS 0.61, rank 1. Covariates: ILINet helped Bes (0.372 -> 0.359) and A4 (0.404 -> 0.366); RSV wastewater (level, rank, growth) and Kinsa did not. Scoring caveat: October 2024 reference dates have no RSV admission history after the mandatory-reporting mask (every model scores 2.336 there) and November 2024 only 1-4 weeks; excluding October-November 2024 leaves the order essentially unchanged (top 5 identical), so the protocol is kept. Round 2: 17 children combining cross-pathogen inputs, calendar off, width, lookback, learning rate, error strength and log-loss weight (round-02.json); six leaders and Bes re-seeded on 48-51 (round-02-reseed.json); covariate round 2 on the three cross-pathogen leaders with ILINet, ILINet + RSV wastewater, ILINet + calendar off (branch-covariates-02.json).

2026-10-13 23:40, after round 2 (r02 68/68, r02-reseed 24/24, cov02 48/48; rankings r02/ranking-12d4ded3c895, r02-reseed/ranking-5bae8cf9fb39, cov02/ranking-d336252b8ba9). Pooled single-seed SD 0.020 (main), 0.024 (covariate problem). States/DC log-admission WIS (lower is better), seeds pooled: B_width256.inputs_all 0.336 (4 seeds), Ba_ll.inputs_all.lr_double 0.337 (4), A4.inputs_all 0.337 (8), Ba_ll.inputs_all 0.338 (8), Ba_ll.inputs_all.calendar_off+width_512 0.338, Ba_ll.inputs_all.log_loss_0.5 0.338, A4.calendar_off 0.340 (8); Bes 0.385 (8). Plateau: no round-2 child beat its parent by more than noise. Worse: error strength 1.5 on Ba_ll.inputs_all (+0.030), lookback 8 combined with calendar off (+0.049 on Ba_ll), A4 lookback 8/width 384. Round-1 Bblk (8 seeds 0.344) and Bes.width_512 (0.345) held up roughly. Hub 2025-26 (states/DC log admissions): leaders' mean WIS ratio to the RSV Hub ensemble 0.85-0.90 (location-mean ratio), pairwise relative WIS 0.63 vs Hub baseline, rank 1 of 7. Note: actual_share=1 has no effect in the 2025-26 fold (the only archived reports it samples are from 2025-26, the held-out season), so Ba_ll and B_width256 variants coincide there. Covariates (cov02): Ba_ll.inputs_all + ILINet + RSV wastewater 0.335 vs no covariate 0.346, ILINet alone 0.351; Bblk.inputs_all ILINet 0.343 vs none 0.368; A4.inputs_all none 0.344, ILINet 0.357: inconsistent, within noise. Round 3 moves to the three-fold problem (2023-24 held out, scored on ED only; user request): the seven leaders refit with 8 seeds (round-03-leaders.json), 13 children on settings never varied (round-03.json), covariates on two leaders with 8 seeds (branch-covariates-03.json).

2026-10-14 00:40: round-3 leaders refit (8 seeds, three folds): B_width256.inputs_all 0.337, A4.inputs_all 0.337, Ba_ll.inputs_all 0.338, A4.calendar_off 0.340; admission scores reproduce round 2 exactly (same seeds, same training seasons give the same models), so the 2023-24 fold only adds an ED score. The main tree is flat. User instruction: if no progress, think outside the box. Round 4 queued before round 3 finished (round-04-branches.json): ED-derived pretraining (new recipe field ed_pretrain_steps, code in experiment/training.py ed_pseudo_panel) and GRU / multiscale-conv encoders. Pseudo-admission scale check (US): ED-derived peaks 17,900 (2022-23) and 14,800 (2023-24) vs observed 15,900 (2024-25) and 8,200 (2025-26).

2026-10-14 08:50, results of round 3 (r03 52/52, cov03 64/64), round 4 (r04 44/44) and mixtures-01 (rsv-tree-20261013-mix01/ranking). All finished by 01:47; the GPUs then sat idle until 08:50 because Claude's waiting process did not resume the session (Claude's failure). Single-recipe, per-seed states/DC log-admission WIS (lower is better): best new nodes B_width256.inputs_all.multiscale_conv 0.333 (4 seeds), A4.inputs_all.multiscale_conv 0.333, B_width256.inputs_all.lookback_10 0.334, linear ED 0.335, A4.inputs_all.gru 0.336, vs B_width256.inputs_all 0.337 (8 seeds): within about one standard error, not yet better than the parent. ED-derived pretraining did not help (B_width256.inputs_all +300 steps 0.337, Ba_ll.inputs_all +1200 0.345, +300 0.350). Covariates with 8 seeds (cov03): B_width256.inputs_all RSV wastewater 0.339 vs none 0.343, ILINet 0.345, ILINet+wastewater 0.343; Ba_ll.inputs_all wastewater 0.345, ILINet 0.348: no covariate helps beyond noise. Mixtures (8 seeds per recipe, equal-weight distribution mixtures, three folds): single-recipe seed mixtures 0.318 (Ba_ll.inputs_all.calendar_off+width_512) to 0.325; best pair Ba_ll.inputs_all.calendar_off+width_512 + A4.calendar_off 0.3105, states/DC log-admission WIS ratio to the RSV Hub ensemble 0.79 (2025-26), pairwise relative WIS 0.59 vs Hub baseline, rank 1 of 7; 50%/95% interval coverage 0.55/0.93 (single seeds 0.35-0.49/0.75-0.88). Mixing seeds and a sampled-family A4 recipe with a quantile-family B recipe fixes most under-coverage. Next: round 5 (round-05.json: re-seed of the new single-recipe leaders and combinations, 8 seeds) and production fits of four candidate recipes on all four seasons (production-01.json, experiment rsv-production-20261014, seeds 42-51).

2026-10-14 15:00, final. Fixed four-recipe mixture (Ball_c0w512, A4c0, A4i, Bw; 8 seeds each) 0.3105 states/DC log-admission WIS on artificial preliminary inputs, 0.3114 replayed on archived Wednesday reports at the RSV Hub deadline (no refit; replay of prescribed fits added to experiment/fit.py). RSV-NET (rsv-rsvnet-20261014, covariates at finalized values, T-1): best gains Bw +RSV-NET 0.333 vs 0.337, Ball_c0w512 +NREVSS 0.334 vs 0.343, but other recipes worse or flat; with covariate reporting errors (rsv-rsvnet-errors-20261014) all within 0.005 of the no-covariate reference; RSV-NET 2014-2022 history pretraining (rsv-rsvnet-pretrain-20261014) worse for every recipe (+0.004 to +0.029). Round 5: B_width256.inputs_all.lookback_10 0.332 (8 seeds) vs 0.337, unconfirmed; other round-4 gains regressed on new seeds. Decision (user rule: ship the four-recipe mixture unless RSV-NET helps): release production/releases/rsv-four-20261014.json from rsv-production-20261014 (all four seasons, seeds 42-51).
